metadata.title: Bump actions/setup-python from 6.1.0 to 7.1.0
metadata.body:
Bumps [actions/setup-python](https://github.com/actions/setup-python) from 6.1.0 to 7.1.0.
Release notes

Sourced from actions/setup-python's releases.

v7.1.0

What's Changed

Enhancements

  • Add mirror and mirror-token inputs for custom Python distribution sources by @​luhenry in actions/setup-python#1302
  • Improve error message clarity by @​v-lmvysakh in actions/setup-python#1351

Dependency Upgrade

  • Upgrade browserslist from 4.28.2 to 4.28.9 by @​dependabot in actions/setup-python#1353
  • Upgrade @​typescript-eslint/parser from 8.62.0 to 8.70.0 by @​dependabot in actions/setup-python#1343
  • Upgrade eslint-plugin-jest from 29.15.2 to 29.16.6 by @​dependabot in actions/setup-python#1342
  • Upgrade @​vercel/ncc from 0.44.0 to 0.45.0 by @​dependabot in actions/setup-python#1357
  • Upgrade @​types/semver from 7.7.1 to 7.8.0 by @​dependabot in actions/setup-python#1359
  • Upgrade undici from 6.28.0 to 6.29.0 by @​dependabot in actions/setup-python#1364
  • Upgrade ts-jest from 29.4.11 to 29.4.14 by @​dependabot in actions/setup-python#1361
  • Upgrade brace-expansion from 5.0.9 to 5.0.12 by @​dependabot in actions/setup-python#1365
  • Upgrade prettier from 3.8.4 to 3.9.9 and package.json from 7.0.0 to 7.1.0 by @​dependabot in actions/setup-python#1363
  • Upgrade @​typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin from 8.62.0 to 8.71.1 by @​dependabot in actions/setup-python#1369
  • Upgrade actions/checkout from 7.0.0 to 7.0.1 by @​dependabot in actions/setup-python#1345
  • Upgrade cache to 6.3.0 by @​v-HarithaVattikuti in actions/setup-python#1370
  • Resolve Basic Validation audit failures by @​v-HarithaVattikuti in actions/setup-python#1347
  • Resolve npm audit failures by @​v-HarithaVattikuti in actions/setup-python#1350

New Contributors

  • @​luhenry made their first contribution in actions/setup-python#1302

Full Changelog: https://github.com/actions/setup-python/compare/v7.0.0...v7.1.0

v7.0.0

What's Changed

Enhancements

  • Migrate to ESM and upgrade dependencies by @​priyagupta108 in actions/setup-python#1330
  • Pin SHA commits and update docs with latest versions by @​HarithaVattikuti in actions/setup-python#1338
  • Remove the pip-install input by @​gowridurgad in actions/setup-python#1336

Bug Fix

  • Fix to Classify stderr warning messages as warnings instead of errors in annotations by @​lmvysakh in actions/setup-python#1335
  • Validate and retry manifest fetch to prevent silent failures by @​priyagupta108 in actions/setup-python#1332

Dependency Upgrade

  • Bump certifi from 2020.6.20 to 2024.7.4 in /tests/data by @​dependabot in actions/setup-python#1328
  • Remove EOL Python versions and Bumps numpy text fixture by @​priya-kinthali in actions/setup-python#1333
  • Upgrade @​actions/cache to 6.2.0 by @​philip-gai in actions/setup-python#1337

New Contributors

  • @​lmvysakh made their first contribution in actions/setup-python#1335
  • @​philip-gai made their first contribution in actions/setup-python#1337

... (truncated)

Commits
  • 6d4fd22 Cache upgrade to 6.3.0 (#1370)
  • ec52d0a Bump @​typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin from 8.62.0 to 8.71.1 (#1369)
  • ff73b24 Bump prettier from 3.8.4 to 3.9.9 and package.json from 7.0.0 to 7.1.0 (#1363)
  • 0e40890 Bump brace-expansion from 5.0.9 to 5.0.12 (#1365)
  • 3892123 Bump ts-jest from 29.4.11 to 29.4.14 (#1361)
  • 6609657 Bump undici from 6.28.0 to 6.29.0 (#1364)
  • e1be392 Bump @​types/semver from 7.7.1 to 7.8.0 (#1359)
  • 06da627 Bump @​vercel/ncc from 0.44.0 to 0.45.0 (#1357)
  • af9bcc7 Bump eslint-plugin-jest from 29.15.2 to 29.16.6 (#1342)
  • 7aeabeb Bump @​typescript-eslint/parser from 8.62.0 to 8.70.0 (#1343)
  • Additional commits viewable in compare view

[![Dependabot compatibility score](https://dependabot-badges.githubapp.com/badges/compatibility_score?dependency-name=actions/setup-python&package-manager=github_actions&previous-version=6.1.0&new-version=7.1.0)](https://docs.github.com/en/github/managing-security-vulnerabilities/about-dependabot-security-updates#about-compatibility-scores) Dependabot will resolve any conflicts with this PR as long as you don't alter it yourself. You can also trigger a rebase manually by commenting `@dependabot rebase`. [//]: # (dependabot-automerge-start) [//]: # (dependabot-automerge-end) ---

You can trigger Dependabot actions by commenting on this PR: - `@dependabot rebase` will rebase this PR - `@dependabot recreate` will recreate this PR, overwriting any edits that have been made to it - `@dependabot show ignore conditions` will show all of the ignore conditions of the specified dependency - `@dependabot ignore this major version` will close this PR and stop Dependabot creating any more for this major version (unless you reopen the PR or upgrade to it yourself) - `@dependabot ignore this minor version` will close this PR and stop Dependabot creating any more for this minor version (unless you reopen the PR or upgrade to it yourself) - `@dependabot ignore this dependency` will close this PR and stop Dependabot creating any more for this dependency (unless you reopen the PR or upgrade to it yourself)
